name: generic-codex-workbench
description: Closed-loop harness workbench for Codex with lane-centric skills, attached current-thread control, and resumable file-backed runtime state.

interface.shortDescription: Lane-centric closed-loop harness for Codex app workflows
interface.longDescription: Use the generic Codex workbench to route harness work, run attached current-thread loops, inspect resumable runs, and keep operator-facing state honest across current-thread, app-server, and headless transports.
defaultPrompt: Route this request into the right harness lane and tell me the next file-backed step.
Use loop-control when the operator wants to start, inspect, resume, or stop a run from the Codex app.
Run the attached loop from the current Codex thread without nested exec calls.
Inspect a persisted run and decide whether to resume, hold, or close it.
